title: Lead Generation
description: Generate high-quality business leads based on specified criteria.

prompt-variables.title: Business description
prompt-variables.placeholder: Exp: A real estate business focused on buying and selling residential properties.

prompt-variables.title: Personality
prompt-variables.display-description: The personality traits of the AI agent.
prompt-variables.editor-llm-description: The desired personality traits and tone for the agent.
prompt-variables.placeholder: Exp: Casual and friendly, like chatting with a colleague.

prompt-variables.title: Instructions
prompt-variables.editor-llm-description: Clear, detailed instructions on what the agent should do, how it should behave, and any boundaries or limitations
prompt-variables.placeholder: Exp: Answer customer questions about available apartments.

prompt-variables.title: Greeting
prompt-variables.display-description: The initial greeting message for users.
prompt-variables.editor-llm-description: The initial greeting message the agent should use. Something like: "Hi, I'm John's assistant, what can I do for you?
prompt-variables.placeholder: Exp: Hi there! I’m your real estate AI — ready to help you find the perfect property.
